title: CI pipeline stage defaults and validation
name: Pipeline stage resolver

questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this code applies default values to each stage? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
A pipeline document has stage 'lint' with a valid run command and an extra key retry: 2, and stage 'test' with needs: ['unit'] where no stage 'unit' exists. What does load_pipeline do?
choices: Raises ConfigError for 'lint' only, because validation stops at the first failing stage
Silently ignores the unknown key and raises only for the missing dependency
Returns both stages and leaves validation to the scheduler
Raises one ConfigError whose problems list contains both the unknown key and the unknown dependency

questions.prompt: The document's defaults section contains needs: ['setup']. What happens?
choices: Every stage gets 'setup' as a dependency
load_pipeline raises ConfigError immediately, before any stage is resolved
The key is dropped, because needs is only meaningful per stage
The error is reported together with any stage-level problems after all stages are checked

questions.prompt: Pipeline defaults set timeout_minutes: 60. Stage 'build' sets retries: 2 and timeout_minutes: 45 and defines nothing else that matters. What does plan() report for 'build'?
